title: Disability Compensation Resumption Releases: Child and School-Child Additions
content:
**Rule.** The child additions in a Disability Compensation resumption release, for every month it covers, are one child addition for each recorded minor child plus one school-child addition for each recorded school child when the award records both; one child addition for each recorded minor child when it records minor children and no school child; one school-child addition for each recorded school child when it records school children and no minor child; and nothing when it records no child. Every addition is taken from the award's own tier.

Minor children recorded are the child additions on the award less the child removals; school children recorded are the school-child additions less the school-child removals.

**Truth table with figures (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (30% Combined Rating))**

| Minor children | School children | Monthly child additions |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 43.83 plus 141.89, that is 185.72 |
| 3 | 0 | 43.83 multiplied by 3, that is 131.49 |
| 0 | 2 | 141.89 multiplied by 2, that is 283.78 |
| 0 | 0 | Nothing |
